description: Recovers actionable context from an interrupted Claude Code session and continues execution in the current conversation.

evals.name: Continue directly from an interrupted session
evals.prompt: My session crashed with ctrl-c, continue work from session 7b92a813-0321-4dbb-b37a-c62dfc1207e7.
evals.expected_output: Runs extract_resume_context.py --session 7b92a813-0321-4dbb-b37a-c62dfc1207e7, reports the session end reason from the briefing, then continues work directly / reports a concrete plan to continue rather than just producing a static summary document.

evals.name: Correctly redirects a portable-document request
evals.prompt: I want a portable recovery document for this session that I can hand to a different, separate session later.
evals.expected_output: Declines to produce a document itself and points to session-resume instead, per its own stated exclusion.

evals.name: Check what I was working on and keep going
evals.prompt: check what I was working on in the last session and keep going
evals.expected_output: Runs extract_resume_context.py (no --session flag, uses latest for current project). Reports the session end reason from the briefing (clean exit, interrupted, error cascade, or abandoned). Presents candidate current request via AskUserQuestion at Step 2.5 (confirmation gate) before any Step 3 actions (Edit, verification commands, tool call retries). Never silently retries or assumes old claims are valid.

uncovered: 'don't resume, just read the .claude files and continue'
